purpose: Machine-readable acceptance contract for evidence registration, classification, adapters, deterministic analysis, semantic retrieval, derived artifacts, provenance, and safe rollout across every NexusAI evidence family.

support_semantics.operational: The bounded vertical slice has an implemented adapter and deterministic fixture-backed verification.
support_semantics.foundation: Registration and classification are implemented, but one or more adapter, query, UI, or benchmark gates remain.
support_semantics.planned: The format is safely registered and visibly routed to a pending or manual-review state; it is not claimed as processed.

global_acceptance.duplicate_registration_behavior: one content-addressed evidence item with every distinct source-entry link preserved
global_acceptance.unknown_column_behavior: preserve raw value and emit schema warning; never silently drop
global_acceptance.partial_failure_behavior: preserve the original evidence and every successful derivative; expose the failed stage
global_acceptance.promotion_rule: No adapter or model becomes a default until its fixed golden fixture passes every required threshold.
global_acceptance.rollback_rule: Retain the previous adapter/model configuration and immutable evidence version until the promoted version is accepted.

metric_registry.classification_f1: Macro F1 for modality and evidence-type classification.
metric_registry.schema_mapping_accuracy: Golden source fields mapped to the correct canonical meaning.
metric_registry.row_preservation_rate: Accepted plus explicitly rejected rows divided by input rows.
metric_registry.exact_answer_agreement: Deterministic query outputs exactly matching golden results.
metric_registry.retrieval_recall_at_5: Gold evidence retrieved in the first five semantic results.
metric_registry.citation_correctness: Citations resolving to the evidence passage or artifact supporting the claim.
metric_registry.unsupported_claim_rate: Material claims without deterministic or cited evidence support.
metric_registry.abstention_accuracy: Unsupported operations correctly reported as unavailable or uncertain.
metric_registry.timestamp_error_ms_p95: 95th percentile timestamp alignment error in milliseconds.
metric_registry.diarization_error_rate: Speaker diarization error rate when diarization is enabled.
metric_registry.detection_precision: Precision for typed visual, plate, face, audio, or event detections.
metric_registry.detection_recall: Recall for typed visual, plate, face, audio, or event detections.
metric_registry.metadata_accuracy: Golden metadata fields extracted exactly or within declared tolerances.
metric_registry.safe_inventory_rate: Archive/database/capture members inventoried or explicitly rejected without unsafe execution.
metric_registry.throughput_items_per_min: Sustained items processed per minute on the declared hardware profile.
metric_registry.peak_ram_mb: Peak resident memory attributable to the adapter or model.
metric_registry.cpu_utilization_pct: Average CPU utilization during the benchmark.
